title: Remove Non-Adherent Patients from Active Outreach
prompt: A pharmacy's adherence program maintains an `active_outreach` table tracking patients enrolled for refill reminders. Program policy requires removing any patient who has refilled fewer than 40% of their eligible prescriptions in the last 90 days, calculated as (total_refills_90d / total_eligible_90d). The `refill_history` table tracks each patient's refill counts. Write a single DELETE statement that removes all non-adherent patients from `active_outreach` based on this threshold. After the DELETE, select all remaining rows from `active_outreach` ordered by `patient_id` to confirm the result.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE active_outreach (patient_id INT PRIMARY KEY, enrollment_date DATE, assigned_pharmacist VARCHAR(50)); CREATE TABLE refill_history (patient_id INT, total_refills_90d INT, total_eligible_90d INT, last_updated DATE);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO active_outreach (patient_id, enrollment_date, assigned_pharmacist) VALUES (101, '2024-01-15', 'Dr. Adams'), (102, '2024-02-20', 'Dr. Baker'), (103, '2024-03-10', 'Dr. Chen'), (104, '2024-01-05', 'Dr. Davis'), (105, '2024-02-28', 'Dr. Evans'), (106, '2024-03-12', 'Dr. Foster'); INSERT INTO refill_history (patient_id, total_refills_90d, total_eligible_90d, last_updated) VALUES (101, 8, 10, '2024-04-01'), (102, 3, 10, '2024-04-01'), (103, 5, 12, '2024-04-01'), (104, 2, 8, '2024-04-01'), (106, 6, 8, '2024-04-01');

composite_moves: filter rows where ratio < 0.40 or no history exists

hints: You need to identify which patients have an adherence rate below the threshold by comparing their refill counts to eligible counts.
Use a subquery in the WHERE clause that calculates the ratio `total_refills_90d / total_eligible_90d` from the refill_history table for each patient.

Delete rows from active_outreach where the patient_id either has no entry in refill_history (use NOT EXISTS or NOT IN) or where the calculated ratio is less than 0.40. Remember to handle division carefully and consider patients with zero eligible prescriptions.
answer_key: DELETE FROM active_outreach WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM refill_history WHERE total_eligible_90d > 0 AND total_refills_90d::DECIMAL / total_eligible_90d >= 0.40); SELECT * FROM active_outreach ORDER BY patient_id;

_meta.scenario: a prescription refill adherence program tracking 30/60/90 day refill rates
